description.name: RackFlow Reseller Provisioning
description.tagline: Provision reseller services through the tenant-scoped RackFlow API
description.long: An independently installable WHMCS module for RackFlow resellers. RackFlow charges the reseller's effective wholesale rate while WHMCS retains complete control of customer-facing retail pricing.
features: Bare-metal, VM, and HTTP proxy provisioning
Idempotent provisioning and stable payment-required errors
Lifecycle, power, status, and client portal SSO
